remarks: Best and final offers due by end of day February 3rd -Welcome to 55 Merriman Road. Located in the desirable Turn of River neighborhood of Stamford, this charming 4 bedroom 2 full bathroom ranch offers the perfect combination of convenience, space, and potential. Set on .24 acres, this property is ideal for those seeking comfortable one level living with added flexibility.  The home features a bright and open layout, with one side of the home offering a spacious living room complete with a cozy fireplace, a formal dining room, and a well-sized kitchen. This side of the home also features two large bedrooms, a full bathroom, and boasts access to a covered porch-perfect for relaxing or entertaining.  The other side of the ranch offers a unique in-law suite with its own private entrance, including a large living room with access to a finished, heated loft area, an open kitchenette with a dinette, a generously sized bedroom, and a full bathroom.  Conveniently located near public transportation, shopping centers, schools, restaurants, parks, and a library, this home is truly in the perfect location for easy access to everything Stamford has to offer.  Don't miss the opportunity to bring your vision to life and make 55 Merriman Road your forever home. Schedule your private tour today!
